0022600009.text: The San Antonio Spurs (0-1, on a one-game losing streak, 4th in the Southwest and 10th in the West) host the Houston Rockets (1-0, on a one-game winning streak, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) in the Spurs' second game of the 2026-27 season. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Houston is without Reed Sheppard (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Spurs won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 145-120 win in San Antonio on March 8, 2026.
